scope: Actual Chromium with explicit management API fixtures; no model or database calls
checks: opening is read-only; primary UI has no tabs or implicit exploration
one explicit save adopts source-wide business context before exploration
typing during an in-flight save remains an unsaved draft across close/reopen
failed save preserves input and exposes an actionable error
one click starts job, prevents duplicate click and leaves chat draft intact
closing and reopening reconnects to durable job without resubmission
completed result exposes existing structural details with safe text rendering
business drafts stay source-scoped; cancellation has a distinct state
failed refresh shows the real failure and keeps last complete result
external edits preserve local draft until user explicitly loads saved content
saved business history can be read without replacing the active draft
desktop 1024/1440 sizes and dark theme fit without page overflow
